references.text: Earlier in the chapter, the same instructions are described for fifty loops for the inner curtains of fine linen, which provide a parallel structure to the instructions for the goat-hair curtains.
Describes the actual execution of the instructions given here, where fifty loops were made on the outer curtain at each joining point.
The next verse describes the fifty bronze hooks that were to be attached in the loops to join the curtains into one tabernacle tent.
Complementary instructions that together give a complete description of how the two curtain pieces are to be prepared for joining.
Logical progression in the construction: dividing the curtains into two groups is the prerequisite for working on the loops along the edge.
Adds detail about placement ('directly opposite'), emphasizing the importance of precision in God's dwelling place.
Confirms that the work with the loops of blue wool was carried out in full accordance with God's specific instructions.
